assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The atrial fibrillation diagnosis is coded I48.91.
The atherosclerotic heart disease diagnosis is coded I25.10.
The CPT code for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is 93229.
This service is medically necessary to evaluate the symptomatic atrial fibrillation and associated heart disease rather than being an uncovered benefit.
